title: Mitsuru and Yukari by the river

cues.text: A path along a riverbank in Kyoto, below a row of wooden terraces. Yukari walks a few steps ahead of Mitsuru.
Yukari steps up to Mitsuru and slaps her across the face.
Mitsuru holds her cheek. Yukari turns away toward the river as people stroll past.
Yukari walks off along the path. Mitsuru stays where she is.

Mitsuru closes her eyes. In a burst of light her Persona, Penthesilea, appears: an armored woman with a crown and blades for arms. It changes into Artemisia, a masked woman with spiked wings and a wide skirt, a whip in her hand.
Back on the path, sparks of light sink into Mitsuru's chest. She stands still as people pass, then smiles.
